definitions: A medical procedure in which a needle is inserted into the lower part of the spinal column to collect cerebrospinal fluid for diagnostic purposes or to inject medication.
A 1984 American mockumentary comedy film directed by Rob Reiner, about a fictional British heavy metal band called Spinal Tap.
examples: The doctor ordered a spinal tap to test for meningitis.
She was nervous about getting a spinal tap.
Spinal Tap is a classic comedy film.
